(nga )༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/shrī badz+ra bhai ra

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa dwi bhu dza na sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// sma ra smin ma ba spu rdzi ma dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing ljags 'dril ba// spyan gsum rwa rnon rnam par 'gyur ba 'jigs gzugs klu 'dab rgya chen ma he'i zhal// g.yon brkyang rab tu khros pa sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng na yongs gnas pa// shin tu rno ba gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa mnyam med bde ba ster la 'dud// phyag dang zhabs ni sna tshogs pa// bsgom pa ru ni mi rung bas// bsdus pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed la// skye bo nus pa mi ldan zhing*// blo dang ldan pa'i ngo ru ni// mdor bsdus pa yi sgrub pa'i thabs// ji ltar de nyid mos pa la'o// sbyor don skyes la bskyed pa'i phyir// las rgyas rgyun du gsungs pa yi// rang gis shes nas rab tu 'jug /gtso bo'i dam tshig rab tu bstan// de yi phyir na rgyas par bshad// sngags pas re zhig thog mar dur khrod dam g.yul la sogs pa'i yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bstan bde ba la gnas nas/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis phyogs bzhi'i bsngags shing byin rlabs pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛ h+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra ra dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya'o// de'i rjes la rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas la sogs pa nam mkha'i phyogs su spyan drangs nas yang dag par mchod pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i cho ga byas nas/ de nas sems can tshad med pa sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho la byings pa'i yul la bltas nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom par bya ste/

de la phan pa dang bde ba nye bar thob par 'dod pa ni byams pa'o// sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las thon par 'dod pa ni snying rje'o// sems can sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral zhing bde la sems pa ni dga' ba'o// de kho na nyid du ro gcig pas rnyed pa dang ma rnyed pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis ma gos pa ni btang snyoms so// bsgom pa de gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par dag pa'i ched du sngags brjod par bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ de'i rjes la chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa rnam par bsgom par bya ba ni/ sems tsam nyid kyi rnam par rtog pa tsam du rtogs nas sngags sngon du bya zhing stong pa nyid kyi sngags brjod pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas thang cig tsam du stong pa nyid du lhag par mos pas de rjes la/ stong pa nyid las yang dag ldan// yam̐ yig du ba las byung bas// rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu dbyibs can// de steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni// a yig sa bon las byung ba// dhīḥlas dhīḥyig 'od 'bar ba// bsgoms nas de yi 'od zer gyis// bder gshegs rgyal ba yang dag bskul// de rnams thams cad yang dag 'dus// 'jam pa'i dbyangs su yang dag bsgom// ral gri pu stis phyag brel ba// gaṅgā gser gyi 'od dang ldan// de yi snying gar bsgom pa ni// a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro// de las 'od zer yang dag byung*// phyogs na rdzogs sangs rgyas bzhugs dang*// khro bo byang chub sems dpa' bcas// de bzhin rigs pa'i lha mo'i tshogs// yang dag nyi ma de nyid la// bskul nas yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// de yang dus gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du ni 'gyur// ro gcig tu ni yang dag byung*// mchog tu shin tu 'od gsal ba// dpag tshad brgya ru rnam rgyas pa// 'jig rten gsum khengs gsal ba dang*// bdud kyi tshogs ni 'joms par byed// yid kyis brtan par bsgom par bya// de yi steng du nag po che// hūm̐ gi 'od zer lnga ldan pa// de las 'od zer nges par 'byung*// de nyid du ni yang dag 'dus// yang ni 'od zer phreng pa yis// 'gro ba ma lus sangs rgyas byas// sangs rgyas lnga po rab sbyor ba// hūm̐ gis de nyid rab sbyor byas// rdo rje chen po rnam gtsigs pa// rtse dgu'i 'od zer shin tu rno// bsgoms nas de yi 'od zer gyis// phra mo'i gzugs kyi rgyal ba sogs// nyi ma yi ni 'od nyid du// gzugs brnyan 'dra bar yang dag blta// de yis sems can yongs su smin// de ni legs par yang dag bsdu// rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan gzugs gcig tu// blo ldan gyis ni bzhugs par 'tshal// de 'od thams cad yongs gyur pa// bskal pa'i me ltar bzod dka' ba// sku mdog nag po drag chen po// 'jigs mdzad ljags ni 'dril ba yi// ma he'i zhal ni sku chen po// 'jig rten gsum po za bar nus// dkon mchog gsum sogs gnod pa la// sdigs mdzub kyis ni mchog tu byas// gzhon nu gdong drug la sogs gsod// lha dang lha min bsdigs par mdzad// dbang po nye dbang drag dang tshangs// ha ha'i sgra ni sgrog par byed// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rab 'joms pa// g.yon brkyangs pa yi zhabs kyis gsod// sa 'og tu ni rab tu g.yo// mgo bo'i phreng ba khrag chen po// thod pa'i cod pan gyis ni mdzes// zhal gyi mche ba gtsigs pa dang*// spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa yis// rwa rnon skra ni 'bar ba bzhin// sma ra smin ma rab 'khyogs 'jigs// sna tshogs chu skyes nyi mar gnas// dbang po yi ni gdangs kas brgyan// thung zhing lto 'phyang brjid pa'o// mtshan ma gyen bsgrengs drag dang bcas// g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag rnams na// thod pa dang ni gri gug 'dzin// sngags pa yis ni rtag tu bsgom// dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed ni// yang na zhal gsum phyag drug bsgom// lhag ma ḍā ru kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

phyag gnyis bgegs kyi pags pa 'dzin// zhal gsum dkar dang dmar ba'o// g.yas dang g.yon gyi bsam gtan ni// drag dang bshad dang 'jigs pa dang*// lhag ma kun ni sngar bzhin no// gshin rje gdug pa ma he'i steng*// de yi steng du mgon nag ni// gcig car du ni yang dag bskyed// rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo yi// phyag dang kha dog mchog tu 'dra// spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa yi// ro yi steng na yang dag gnas// gdug pa can rnams bsad pa'i phyir// snying rje'i bdag nyid kyis ni bsgom// de rjes ye shes sems dpa' dgug /ji lta ba yi cho gas gzhug /mchod yon zhabs bsil la sogs sbyin// dam tshig la ni yang dag gzhug /de nas dbang bskur yang dag sbyin// rigs kyi bdag pos spyi bor brgyan// mnyam par bzhag pas sngags bzlas pas// 'bum phrag gsum gyi grangs nges par// myur du 'gro ba'i don ni bya// sngags pas skyo bar gyur na ni// langs nas bya ba gzhan dag kyang*// smon lam de bzhin byas nas ni// rnal 'byor blo ldan de nas blang*// sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni// snying rje'i bdag nyid sngags bzlas pa// 'bum phrag gsum gyis grangs nges par// 'grub pa 'di ni the tshom med// sngags ni yig bcu rgyun mi bcad// rgyun de ji srid bzlas pa na// ring dang thung dang bul ba ma yin blo ldan smra bar gyur pas thams cad du// dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed sku ni sngags pas mi spangs dngos grub kyi ni gzhi// nges par sems ni brtan byas mngon par 'dod pa'i ji srid mtshan ma ma byung bar du'o// de nas rnal 'byor snying rje'i mchog /khros pa'i nga rgyal yid kyis ni// byas dang rdo rje can gyis bsad// 'jigs byed bsad pa'i lan ni gtso// gshin rje'i gzugs ni bya ba yi// grog mkhar bdun gyis yang dag byung*// 'jigs byed rnal 'byor ldan pa yis// dus sogs shes pas 'dus byas la// gcer bu ral gri mi mgo bzung*// gsus pa che la zhal gcig pa// skra ser gyen brdzes mig dmar ba// gdug sems can ni 'jigs pa yi// des na khru gang tsam gyi tshad// mi thod la bris snying gar gzhug

/bla ma'i man ngag rtogs pa yi// de yi sgrub thabs legs par sbyar// kha sbyor dbye bar byas nas ni// srung ba dgag pa'i sbyor ba dang*// lus ni stong par gyur pa la// bsad na dngos grub myur du thob// gshin rje'i lus ni yongs rdzogs shing*// bsgrub bya mdun du byas nas ni// nyi ma bdun gyi grangs kyis ni// ji lta'i cho ga thun gsum gyis// bzlas dang sbyin sreg sogs rdzogs dang*// mngon sum du ni mtshan ma thob// mtshan phyed kyi ni dus su bya// mi mgo gsum gyi steng du brdung*// khro bo'i nga rgyal sems kyis ni// 'di ltar brtan byas rnal 'byor pas// gang bstan de ni byas pa na// thams cad bor nas nges par 'gro// gang yang 'dir ni dmyal ba yang*// spangs nas bde ba can du 'gro// sngags dang rgyud kyi mthu dang ni// bsam gtan bsam bya rnal 'byor pas// sdig pa chen po byas pa yang*// de ni thabs kyi sbyin pa yin// nye bar bya ba'i thabs yin no// gzhan du na ni skyon du 'gyur// rdo rje 'jigs byed la gus pas// gsol ba btab la thugs brtse'i gnas// rin chen rdo rje zla ba ltar// 'di nyid la gus bdag gis sbyar// ji ltar thob pa'i dge ba des// bde ba sgrub pa'i sgrub thabs 'di// chung du 'dod pa'i sems can ni// des ni rdo rje 'jigs byed shog /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po ātsar+ya ā nan+da dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs grub pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra bhai ra wā ya/ ro gcig zhal dang bden gnyis mtshon pa'i phyag /skyon drug gcod phyir rdo rje gri gug dang*// bde chen ros gang thod pa khrag bcas kyis// phyag gnyis sbas pa'i he ru ka la 'dud// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa bsgom par 'dod pas/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sdig sgrib dag ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal chen po la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas dbur brgyan pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra bhai ra wi bh+yaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wā ya ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs tshogs zhing rang la bstim/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog ser po g.yas ral gri g.yon ut+pal gyi steng na pusti 'dzin pa skyil krung gis bzhugs shing dar dang rin po ches spras pa/ de'i thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od 'phros pas dpal chen po'i sku dang*/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs te 'jam dpal la thim pas thig le gnyis su gyur pa las 'og gi thig le las ma he sngo nag rus pa'i drwa bas rgyab g.yogs pa/ steng gi thig le hūm̐ las gri gug yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros phyi snod gzhal yas khang dang nang bcud lha mor gyur pa tshur 'dus pa las/ rang nyid dpal khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ma he'i zhal can spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/

dbu skra smin ma ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas ma he'i rwa bar dang*/ g.yon brkyangs pas tshang ra'i steng du brdzis pa/ gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po/ rna bar dziṃ sngon po/ snar kham̐ ser po/ lcer gam̐ dmar po/ dpral bar kaṃ ljang gu/ lte bar saṃ dkar po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī hūm̐ zhes pas dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs te/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang oṃ ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra yak+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams ci nus bzlas la/ mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/

oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du mtshan sngags sbyar ba'i pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da rnams kyis mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la mtshan sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas phul la/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa// zhe sdang gshin rje'i rdo rje ni// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// thugs rje'i sprul pa'i skur ston pa// ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa// dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud// ces pas bstod/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyang*/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ shar du bi las dri chen/ lhor ma las klad pa/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ra las khrag dbus su hūm̐/ shar du bhūm̐/ lhor am̐/ nub tu dz+rīm̐/ byang du kham̐/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas zhu ba'i rlangs pa sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur/ de'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ byas gdan phul/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/

oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+riḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa sarba bigh+nan sha truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ gong bzhin phyi nang gis mchod/ bstod pa dang 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ phrin las bcol/ gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ smon lam bkra shis bya'o// zhes dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs shin tu gsal ba 'di'ang rwa chen dang bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab kyi don ngag 'don du bsgrigs/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang yi ger mkho ba'i lhan thabs su/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang gsum

sa skya pa/ mkhyen rab rje/ rig 'dzin chen po/ gyi bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal shākya'i btsun pa ā nan+da ni ra bho gas dpal ldan rmor gyi bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis/ 'dis kyang tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par gyur cig/ ༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga grub pa'i dgongs rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis// gzung 'dzin bdud sde 'jigs byed pa// bla ma 'jam dpal khros pa la// btud nas de yi rjes gnang 'bri// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal gyi khar tshom bu gcig de'i mdun du mchod gtor/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag gi rnal 'byor rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs grub pa'i zhal lung ltar nyams su blangs rjes/ tshom bu hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du dhīḥlas ral gri sogs nas/ dbur brgyan ces pa'i bar tshig gi kha bsgyur cung zad tsam ma gtogs bdag bskyed ltar gsal btab/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams mngon rtogs ltar dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar dmigs te bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod par/ me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa zhe sdang thabs rgyud dmar nag 'jigs gsum du grags pa las byin rlabs dang dngos grub kyi gter du gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skor la/

'phags bod du sgrub thabs dang man ngag gi bka' srol mtha' yas par byon pa las/ 'dir slob dpon chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags sogs kyis legs par bkral zhing*/ lam 'di la mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las rim par 'ongs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa/ thog mar slob dpon la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas rdo rje thal mo me tog dang bcas pa snying gar sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// sogs zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes bya ba rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba gsum las/ thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du/ slob dpon rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos su gsal ba la gus 'dud drag po mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/

mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung lha 'dres byad du bcug pa sogs spang bya mi mthun pa'i tshogs dang*/ der ma zad rnam smin gdos bcas kyi lus kyang mi dmigs par sbyangs te 'od kyi gong bu re rer gyur/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs dang*/ zhes brjod pas 'od phung brtan g.yo'i chos dang bcas 'od gsal stong nyid nam mkha'i dbyings lta bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo dhīḥyig gser gyi mdog can las ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa sogs nas/ hūm̐ sngon po zhes pa'i bar rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor ba tsam ma gtogs mngon rtogs ltar gsal gdab/ slar yang slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'og min dang*/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling na bzhugs pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku'i rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam nas/ chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi bar tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bye tshan la kha ba babs pa ltar sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying rnams sbrel mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes yang yang brjod cing spos rol dang bcas ye shes pa dbab cing bstim/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng skar ma lta bus bskor ba dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma la rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag re gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du sngags phreng gnyis pa lan gsum byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar hūm̐ gi mtha' mar dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas brtan par byas/ gsum pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa dang bcas te sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces brda sprad la sngags rnams lan gsum bzlar gzhug slar yang slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags phreng brtan cing nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das 'di la sogs/ dam bca' ba'i slad du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du/ slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas sogs gong ltar la/ de thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/

rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i rdo rje la thim pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid nga yin snyam du bsgoms la cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ mjug gi chos dam tshig khas blang sogs spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa gsos bsang sbyangs byin rlabs/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ rang gi mig tu k+ṣiṃ sogs skye mched dang gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar bya'o// bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi// rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga ni// grub pa'i dgongs rgyan 'dir sbyar bas// 'gro kun 'jam dbyangs nyid thob shog /ces pa'ang bya bral ba mañju gho ṣas rang 'dra'i blo dman rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i slad du/ gnas gsar pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don ji lta bar nag 'gros bklag chog tu bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
